samples.text:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends were playing hide and seek, but Lily's friends were having a great time. Lily was scared of the dark and she wanted to go home.
But her mom said, "Don't worry, Lily. The wind'll protect your hair." Lily gave her a hug and said, "You're safe too."
Lily felt better and said, "I can't wait to go back to sleep."
She went back home with her mom. But then she remembered her mom's words. She promised to take a bathtub and play with her.
